title: Mirror-preview: simulated validation path for pinned model promotions
text:
Mirror-preview: simulated validation path for pinned model promotions

description:
Problem: When promoting a pinned model revision to live traffic we need high-confidence checks for quality regressions, latency/cost regressions, and safety issues without affecting production traffic. Existing shadow and canary approaches either add live risk or require complex cohort instrumentation. Proposal: implement a 'mirror-preview' simulated validation path that runs a deterministic mirrored copy of incoming requests through candidate pinned revisions with configurable fidelity (metadata-only, short-sampled context, or full-token simulation). The mirror-preview produces structured comparison signals (semantic similarity, token-cost delta, latency delta, safety heuristic diffs, and structured output schema diffs) and feeds those into gating rules to allow either automated promotion, limited weighted rollouts, or manual approval.

acceptance_criteria:
Mirror-preview can be enabled behind a pin flag per-customer and per-route via the Console and API
Mirror-preview supports three fidelity modes: metadata-only, sampled-context (prefix up to N tokens), full-token-simulate
Structured comparison metrics emitted to telemetry: semantic_sim, response_md5, tokens_delta, latency_ms_delta, safety_score_delta, schema_mismatch_count
A new gating config in Console can declare pass/fail thresholds for these signals and trigger automated promotion or rollback actions
Telemetry dashboards and per-pin reports show aggregated regressions and per-request examples for triage
End-to-end test coverage for the mirror-preview path and gating logic with synthetic traffic harness

steps:
Design API flags and Console UI for enabling mirror-preview on a pinned revision
Spec the fidelity modes and what is recorded/returned in each mode
Implement non-blocking mirroring in serving runtime that forks requests into a simulation pipeline
Build comparison library: semantic similarity (embedding cosine with fallback), token accounting, structured output diffing, and safety heuristics scoring
Add gating rules engine with threshold configs and alerting actions (notify, block-promotion, auto-promote)
Create Console dashboard tile and raw logs explorer for mirror-preview events
Run staged rollout internally on Canary orgs then opt-in beta customers
Collect feedback, tune thresholds, and ship as opt-in in runtime-2.4

risks:
Extra compute for simulation can increase cost on high QPS routes; need quota and sampling to bound spend
Simulated runs might diverge from live outputs due to nondeterminism (sampling tokens, random seeds) leading to false positives
Privacy/regulatory concerns for mirroring PII: must support redaction and customer opt-out
Over-reliance on semantic metrics could miss subtle safety regressions—need human-in-loop review for high-risk pins

decisions:
Mirror-preview will be opt-in per-pin; default off for hosted tenants
Sampling default: 1% full-token, 5% sampled-context, rest metadata-only for high-volume routes
Use embedding-based semantic_sim as primary similarity metric with configurable thresholds; fallback to token-level heuristics when embeddings unavailable
Telemetry retention for mirror events will be limited to 30 days for default tier and configurable for enterprise

updates:
2026-02-20: Kickoff meeting with runtime, telemetry, and security. Agreed on opt-in model and sampling defaults.
2026-02-26: Prototype merged for metadata-only mirroring; started ingest pipeline in telemetry-service. Marco verified low overhead in staging.
2026-03-01: Embedding similarity hook implemented (server-side batch embed). Early experiments show useful signal for summarization workloads.
2026-03-03: Security sign-off requested for PII handling; added redaction mode and enterprise-only full retention opt-in.
2026-03-05: Began internal canary on 'redwood-internal' org with 2 non-critical routes. No regressions observed; cost delta ~0.8% at 1% sampling. Next: implement gating editor in Console.
